items.caption: This Shang oracle-script form of 分 places marks on either side of 刀, matching the analysis of a knife separating two things. The early form is also analyzed as having 八 as a phonetic element.
items.alt: Black oracle-script glyph with a central knife-like stroke and two curving strokes on either side.
items.selection_reason: The visible arrangement helps illustrate the separation analysis, while the database account adds a proposed phonetic role for 八. The image alone cannot establish either interpretation.

limitations.text: The form is a modern vector redrawing, not an artifact photograph. Its broad Shang dating and oracle-script identification come from the file description; the exact date and the historical functions of its parts remain uncertain.
